system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded creation of ext.rwong by nora.blake at 13:47:08 UTC.
The new account was added to the Freelancers group by nora.blake; this matches the stated help-desk account-creation practice.
A network logon for nora.blake from WS-NBLAKE-01 was recorded on the domain controller, and its logon ID matches the subject logon ID on the account-creation event.
At 14:00 UTC, nora.blake launched Remote Desktop to DC-NWD-01 from WS-NBLAKE-01, and the domain controller recorded a RemoteInteractive logon for her from that workstation.

The RDP activity is inconsistent with the supplied practice that remote administration is performed only by sam.okafor from WS-SOKAFOR-01. This is suspicious, but the available records do not establish malicious intent or what nora.blake did in the RDP session.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show the RDP connection and session startup, but do not show subsequent commands, administrative-tool use, or other actions within that session.
The supplied records do not show the request or business justification for creating ext.rwong.
The records provided cover only the specified one-hour window and may not capture related activity before or after it.
claims_not_established: Whether the RDP session was authorized as an exception or was performed by nora.blake without authorization.
Whether the account was enabled, used, or given any privileges beyond the observed Freelancers group membership.
Whether ext.rwong was requested by a legitimate business sponsor.
Whether the RDP session involved changes to the domain controller or other malicious activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Confirm with the help desk and IT whether nora.blake had authorization to RDP to DC-NWD-01 at this time, and obtain the ticket or business justification for the account.
Collect domain-controller process, PowerShell, directory-service, and relevant security audit logs for nora.blake's RDP session and the account's creation and subsequent use.
Review ext.rwong's account status, group memberships, logons, and activity after creation.
Correlate workstation and domain-controller authentication records to determine how the RDP session was initiated and whether any other host or account was involved.
